name: dither-aperture
title: Dither Aperture
description: A bounded ordered-dot veil with a configurable focal point and an intrinsic 16:9 default size.

accessibility.notes: The dot veil is static and decorative; supplied media keeps its semantics and the aspectRatio prop prevents a zero-height install.

performance.budget: Three CSS gradients and one mask; no raster texture, script, or animation loop.
